page: Amazon Web Services x2gd.medium is a memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture, powered by custom arm64 AWS Graviton2 processors utilizing Neoverse-N1 cores. The configuration provides 1 dedicated virtual CPU running at 2.5 GHz with a single physical core and one thread per core. The processor features 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache. System memory is sized at 16 GB, creating a wide 1:16 compute-to-memory ratio. Local instance storage is included via a 59 GB NVMe solid-state drive. There are no onboard graphics processing units, and baseline network throughput is rated at 0 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations highlight the balance between single-threaded compute and core-count limitations. In stress-ng testing, the server produces 1500.69 in both single-core and multi-core evaluations. Geekbench records a single-core score of 947.0 and a multi-core score of 946.0, with Clang software compilation reaching 1161.0. Memory bandwidth benchmarks record 59.36 GB/sec for small cached reads and 18.72 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside 9.47 GB/sec for write throughput. In database and service testing, Passmark database operations register at 631.41, while Redis SET throughput achieves 1.19 million operations per second. Light inference on a 135M parameter model reaches 37.97 tokens per second for prompt ingestion and 29.5 tokens per second for text generation.

The hardware design represents a targeted cost-efficiency tradeoff, maximizing RAM allocation and low-latency NVMe scratch space per compute core. While overall multithreaded compute throughput is constrained by the single-core profile, the high memory density avoids paying for unnecessary CPU cores when hosting memory-bound tasks. Amazon Web Services x2gd.medium is well matched for in-memory key-value stores such as Redis, lightweight relational databases, memory-heavy microservices, caching layers, and background data processing tasks.
description: Amazon Web Services x2gd.medium is an arm64 memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an AWS Graviton2 Neoverse-N1 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance allocates 1 dedicated vCPU mapped to a single physical core, paired with 16 GB of system RAM for an expansive 1:16 compute-to-memory ratio. Ephemeral local storage is provided by an integrated 59 GB NVMe solid-state drive, while GPU hardware is omitted. Benchmark results show average single-threaded execution with a stress-ng score of 1500.69 and a Geekbench single-core score of 947.0, with multi-core scores bounded by the single-core limit. The instance demonstrates solid in-memory performance, sustaining 1.19 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads. Providing high memory density alongside fast local NVMe storage, x2gd.medium is designed for in-memory caching tiers, lightweight databases, containerized services, and memory-intensive applications requiring modest processing power.
